conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: That's really impressive. How do they learn to do all those things?

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: They learn through a process called "training," where they are fed vast amounts of data and adjust their internal connections based on the feedback they receive. This iterative process allows them to identify increasingly complex patterns.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: So they essentially teach themselves by looking at lots of examples?

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Exactly! They adjust their internal parameters until they can accurately identify patterns and make predictions from the data.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
